request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Findings so far**", "2": "**Failure:** Static flow composition carried no signal.", "3": "A smoothed level comparison of V02 against V03 gave a mean IC near 0.01 (t about 0.4).", "4": "A three-month shift of V02 against V04 also failed, with IC essentially zero.", "5": "**Partial success:** Groups whose V03 rate rose faster than their V02 rate over three months, relative to peers, outperformed modestly (IC 0.06, t about 2.1).", "6": "The effect appears only in low common-index periods (IC 0.12) and disappears when the index is high.", "7": "Restricting to low regimes gave t about 3.6 but only 58 percent coverage.", "8": "That gain is largely mechanical rather than independent evidence."}, "hypothesis": "Final robustness check, data-informed by submissions 2 and 4: if relative V03 rises over V02 genuinely predict outperformance, seasonally neutral year-over-year changes should also predict higher relative returns next month, in both T regimes.", "expression": "spread(yoy(V03),yoy(V02))"}
